title: Concurrent claims omitted from local board
finding: The checkout's COORDINATION.md had no active NFL claim, but remote branches contained several overlapping NFL scopes. Work was moved into this unique assurance directory; no competing file was overwritten.
action: Final integrator must reconcile append-only boards and preserve canonical NFL contributions.

title: Repository is not an NFL-only project
finding: Baseline a989d67 contains 150 files / 14,244 text lines spanning NBA, operator evidence and two rental sections. Old counts refer to earlier baselines, not this checkout.
action: Keep archives; use the exact baseline permalink for this independent coverage audit.

title: NFL data-use restriction
finding: NFL.com terms §1.3 restrict systematic retrieval and commercial use; §12 prohibits using Services to gamble/wager on NFL games. No separate permission is evidenced.
action: Informational audit only; NFL-derived betting-price release, automated bulk collection and wagering remain disabled.

title: Injury report is not a depth chart
finding: The official table has 276 rows across 26 teams. Blank game/injury cells are not proof of health or final availability. LAC and BAL display No Injuries Reported for this early-week view, not a verified zero-injury roster.
action: Preserve blanks; reconcile final inactives and club lineup evidence separately.

title: Official club domains can publish unofficial charts
finding: Patriots.com explicitly labels its chart writers' opinions; Detroit labels its football-communications chart unofficial. Official publication does not make the ordering a confirmed starting lineup.
action: Label printed order, not confirmed starter truth; never infer a replacement from DNP alone.

title: Shared cells and missing depth columns
finding: Seattle WR, Arizona OLB and Pittsburgh TE contain multiple names in one printed cell. Washington LB has a blank second column followed by a third-column name; Miami K is empty.
action: Do not assign arbitrary ranks, compress gaps or invent a replacement. Shared listings have null individual rank.

title: No verified chart publication timestamp
finding: The checked rendered club charts do not supply a reliable machine-readable effective timestamp in the returned content.
action: Use retrieval date only; do not claim the chart was published or unchanged on that date.

title: News expectations are not final participation
finding: Seattle's Lock, Miami's McCord, Cleveland's Watson and Arizona's Beck have named expected-start reports. These are distinct from final inactive/participation confirmation.
action: Keep announcement evidence separate; do not convert expected into guaranteed or infer replacement performance.

title: Third-party status disagreement excluded
finding: A search result from a third-party aggregator showed statuses conflicting with the official league injury table. It was not used to fill any field.
action: Use official league/club rows for this snapshot; retain published-vs-published conflicts for review when they occur.

title: No actual NFL fair line or leg correlation
finding: No authorized fitted scoring panel, operator offers or aligned settled prop thresholds are present. Generic math tests use synthetic numbers only.
action: Leave actual probabilities, lines, correlations, ROI and CLV blank; discover prerequisites through P01–P07.

title: Luck cannot be eliminated
finding: Proper scores, chronological tests and multiplicity correction reduce avoidable evaluation errors but do not remove random outcomes or establish guaranteed skill.
action: No skill guarantee, cash prize or qualified winner until prospective all-gate evidence exists.

title: Source capture is not a raw archive
finding: Values were compared with Arena-rendered official pages. The sandbox's direct NFL HTTPS request failed; a manual-dispatch collector exists but was not registered on the default branch and could not be dispatched.
action: Treat hashes as transcription integrity, not original-response proof. Run bounded capture only after rights review and default-branch workflow registration.

title: Guessed operations URLs returned 404
finding: Two guessed operations.nfl.com injury/roster paths returned NFL 404 pages. They are excluded from evidence; the readable league policy announcement and calendar are used instead.
action: Do not cite a guessed official-looking URL as verification. Full current personnel-policy coverage remains incomplete.

title: Rulebook fetch has a page limit
finding: The official 2026 rulebook was identified and its preface/early pages read, but the fetch tool exposes only the first 30 PDF pages. Later scoring/overtime details were not independently read in full.
action: Do not claim a full rulebook audit; verify exact later rule sections before settlement implementation.

title: Static shortlist is not shared approval
finding: The suggestions UI can save a browser-local shortlist and export it. There is no identity, shared database or audit trail capable of granting implementation approval.
action: Require a reviewed, versioned decision record before implementation; do not label a local click Approved.

title: Identity aliases are explicit and limited
finding: Only Kevin Byard III/Kevin Byard, Ronnie Hickman/Ronnie Hickman Jr. and Mack Wilson Sr./Mack Wilson are normalized across the checked club/league rows. No fuzzy matching is used.
action: Review aliases against stable player IDs when an authorized roster feed exists; unmatched means unknown, not healthy.
